note: Declared corrections to the Arabic scan. Applied by scripts/podcast/correct_ocr.py, which keeps the vowelled sibling in step and re-stamps the staleness hash. Each entry states the reading the scan carries, the reading it should carry, and why — so a fixed scanner error can never be mistaken later for a manuscript variant.

corrections.context: إن الأمر الذي دعوتكم إليه هو الذي أكرمه الله لعباده
corrections.evidence: "I called you" — root د-ع-و, 212 occurrences in the Quranic corpus (content/knowledge-base/quranic-corpus/morphology.db). دعوث is not a word in any form; ت and ث differ by a single dot, the commonest confusion in this scan. Surfaced because the vowelling gate refused the whole surrounding run rather than accept a changed letter.

corrections.context: كذلك هؤلاء الذين ضيعوا منهاج رسلهم ألجأهم الجهل إلى طلب العلم
corrections.evidence: "drove them to" — form IV of ل-ج-أ. The scan reads the initial hamza (أ) as a bare alif, which turns the verb into the definite article plus a non-word. The sentence needs a verb here: الجهل (ignorance) is its subject and إلى طلب العلم its complement.
